info.title: Accounting API
info.description: Accounting API for the first-party SPA and third-party systems. Contract: .docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

sessionCookie.description: First-party SPA: session cookie from the login flow, plus the XSRF-TOKEN cookie echoed in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on writes.
sessionCookie.name: accounting_session

bearerAuth.description: Integration clients: OAuth 2.0 client-credentials access token. Treat it as opaque. Writes require an Idempotency-Key header.
